description: Fix 4 client-server event payload mismatches from v3 review: CurrencyUpdated, UpgradeUpdated, CampaignVictory, and EggHatchStart/EggHatchResult
steps: Fix CurrencyService.lua to send two positional args (data.coins, data.diamonds) instead of a table
Fix UpgradeService.lua to send the full data.upgrades table instead of (upgradeId, level)
Fix Main.client.lua CampaignVictory handler to accept (levelNum, rewards) and pass rewards
Fix Main.client.lua EggHatchStart/EggHatchResult handlers to not expect position parameter
Fix EffectsController.lua showEggHatchAnimation to use player character position as fallback
acceptance_criteria: CurrencyUpdated fires two positional args that match client handler signature (coins, diamonds)
UpgradeUpdated fires the full upgrades table matching client handler signature (upgrades)
CampaignVictory client handler accepts both (levelNum, rewards) and passes rewards to onVictory
EggHatchStart/EggHatchResult client handlers work without position parameter from server
EffectsController egg hatch animation uses player character position as fallback when no world position provided
BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx is valid XML after regeneration
verification: Run: python3 -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; ET.parse('/projects/Roblox-game/BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx'); print('Valid')"
Verify CurrencyService no longer sends table payload
Verify UpgradeService sends full upgrades table
Verify CampaignVictory handler accepts two arguments
Verify EggHatchStart/EggHatchResult handlers do not expect position
findings: All 4 v3 review payload mismatches resolved. CurrencyService had 4 FireClient calls all sending a table - changed all to two positional args. UpgradeService changed from (upgradeId, level) to full data.upgrades table. CampaignVictory client handler now accepts (levelNum, rewards) and passes rewards. EggHatch handlers use player character position (HumanoidRootPart + offset) for animation origin instead of expecting server-sent position. Added nil guard in EffectsController.showEggHatchAnimation. BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx regenerated and validated (212,670 bytes, 92 items).
